test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Gurpreet went to a shop and bought a sofa. She got a 20% discount on it. Had she received 30% discount, she would have saved ₹1,000 more. How much did she pay for the sofa?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** According to the question, 10% of MP = ₹1000 ⇒ Purchased Price = 80% of MP = ₹8000
